name: TLDR InfoSec
why: 5-minute daily roundup of breaches, vulns and identity news. The one Dad forwarded; it gives you talking points for interviews.

name: tl;dr sec
why: Best weekly curation of cloud security, AppSec and AWS/Azure IAM tooling. Respected by hiring managers.

name: SANS NewsBites
why: Top stories with expert commentary. Quick way to sound current in interviews.

name: CISA Cybersecurity Alerts & Advisories
why: Official US alerts on exploited vulns (KEV). Real identity-attack advisories you can quote.

name: Microsoft Entra Blog
why: New Entra ID, PIM, Conditional Access features. This is your SC-300 and day-job platform.

name: SANS OUCH!
why: Short security-awareness newsletter. Good for explaining security to non-tech users.

name: Risky Business News
why: Sharp daily news, plus a podcast for your commute.

name: The Hacker News
why: Wide coverage of breaches and vulnerabilities.

name: Dark Reading
why: Enterprise security news including identity and access.

name: SecurityWeek
why: Industry news plus their identity/IAM coverage.

name: Krebs on Security
why: Deep investigations into account takeover, MFA bypass and fraud.

name: Unsupervised Learning
why: Security + AI + career thinking. Helps you connect AI skills to cyber.

name: Simply Cyber
why: Career-focused community for breaking into and growing in cyber.

name: Okta Blog / Identity newsletter
why: Workforce and customer identity trends from a top IAM vendor you'll see in job posts.

name: SailPoint Blog
why: Identity governance (IGA) ideas: access reviews, JML. Many IAM jobs ask for SailPoint.

name: CyberArk Blog
why: Privileged access (PAM) best practices; PAM skills raise IAM pay.

name: IDPro Newsletter
why: The professional body for identity people; news, Body of Knowledge, CIDPRO cert.

name: Identity Defined Security Alliance (IDSA)
why: Vendor-neutral identity security best practices and research.

name: AWS Security Blog
why: AWS IAM, Identity Center and policy updates; builds on your APTASK AWS IAM work.

name: Cybersecurity Jobs by Infosec-Jobs
why: Weekly email of new security job openings, including remote IAM roles.
